items.title: My AI Agent Army Opens an AI Agent Factory and Publishes the Real Output of 17 Built-and-Tested Agents
items.summary: My AI Agent Army opens an AI agent factory for businesses and publishes real reports and drafts from 17 agents it has already built and tested.
items.content_text: My AI Agent Army, an AI agent factory operated by Denver's Eye To Ad Media, is now taking orders at [myaiagentarmy.com](https://www.myaiagentarmy.com/). Businesses can order a single agent or hundreds, either ready-made from the company's agent templates or custom-built from scratch. With the launch, the company published the actual reports and drafts from 17 agents it has already built and tested, run on a sample plumbing company, at [myaiagentarmy.com/see-them-work](https://www.myaiagentarmy.com/see-them-work/). Most AI agent offers today are demos or chat windows. The sample-output page is meant to show what the agents produce before anyone buys: a morning briefing that caught a double booking, replies drafted to three overnight leads, a three-month profit and loss built from raw bank exports, a renewal report that flagged an expired insurance policy, and an AI-readiness audit with the fix files it wrote.
